www-10840360.name: Civilian RP
www-10840360.author: Bosko-Lasta
www-10840360.description: This game is different from typical Adopt Me games, which are seen as boring and poorly made. In this game, the main focus is on living an ordinary life rather than just adopting. There is a city, town, and island. There are also many places like a theater, orphanage, amusement park, and a prison. This focuses on functionality more, for instance, paying at stores, unlike other games that are mainly visual. Brands like McDonald’s are not included, and everything is designed in a KoGaMa style.
